name: narrator
description: Click ⏸︎ narrator off in the footer, or /narrator, and after each turn Claude tells you out loud what it did, in your language, with the best free voice your system has: Siri's on macOS, Narrator's on Windows, speech-dispatcher's on Linux.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: A voice's name (Mónica, Microsoft Helena, or Eddy (es-MX) for one language's) to always speak with; /narrator voices lists them. Empty: the best voice installed for the language Claude speaks, or the English one where that language has none.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language to always narrate in, as a language code (es, en, pt); an unknown one is ignored. Empty: the language you write in.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the voice speaks, as a multiple of its normal pace: 1 is the voice's own, 1.5 half as fast again.

model.title: Model that writes the narration
model.description: An alias (haiku) or a full model id.

shortAnswer.title: Read short answers as they are
shortAnswer.description: An answer up to this many characters is read out as it is, with no model call to narrate it. 0: always narrate.

command.title: Speak command
command.description: A program of your own to say each narration with, in place of the system's voice (macOS, Windows and Linux): the system shell runs it with the narration as its last argument; Windows batch scripts read NARRATOR_TEXT instead. Empty: the system's voice.
